speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are an 8-year-old having trouble sleeping and waking up frightened. To help you, I need to ask: Do you recall any dreams or nightmares when this happens?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Night Terror Disorder (Sleep Terrors). 

Based on the history of abrupt awakening with fear and crying in an 8-year-old, followed by immediate orientation and consolability without confusion, this presentation is classic for sleep terrors rather than nightmares or other sleep disorders.
